method.alignment: TradingView-like year-reset non-overlapping N exchange sessions; single-symbol suspended days marked non-complete
method.dataCut: last completed trading day strictly prior to posted date; no post intraday OHLC, no future bars
method.redEngulf: bullish candle real body fully wraps previous bearish candle real body
method.fullRangeEngulf: bullish candle high >= previous high AND low <= previous low AND previous bearish
method.formingBars: displayed only as provisional, NEVER confirmed before all N sessions close
method.caveat: Yahoo 1D aggregation approximates TradingView 3D/18D, session differences and corporate adjustments possible
